resources.string: Full CarPlay in Dudu’s map card

Select DiPlay in Dudu’s AMap plugin. The card shows the complete interactive CarPlay screen. It keeps the connection and aspect ratio when resized. Dudu handles wheel keys; DiPlay publishes day/night status and a standard music session.

In Dudu, select DiPlay as the music source and enable notification access for Dudu. Track information, artwork, playback state and position come from the iPhone; play, pause and track controls return to the iPhone. Position seeking is not available. Open CarPlay to use DiPlay settings.
Overlay permission is required to show CarPlay in Dudu.
This head unit has no notification access settings page. Enable Dudu’s music access from its settings.
CarPlay overlay could not be shown. Check overlay permission and the Dudu map card settings. Details are in the connection log.
